statusDetail: The requested host redirects in Chrome to a public Telegram channel; the redirect destination and its channel, post, and search surfaces were audited.

page.notes: blacktoon410.com returned a browser-visible 301 to https://t.me/s/blacktoonlink. Curl received a Cloudflare 403 under a different client condition, recorded as evidence.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The final Telegram channel changes from light surfaces to dark surfaces under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, document.getAnimations() returned no animations; the page has no auto-advance or non-essential motion.

checkOutcomes.method: Contrast preference probe plus Lighthouse contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: No prefers-contrast or forced-colors CSS was found, and Lighthouse measured several sub-threshold combinations, including the Join action at 3.31:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered route/search walkthrough and CSS probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The search result is a full document navigation and the stylesheet probe found no view-transition declarations, so state/route changes swap abruptly.
The channel has no parallax, scrollytelling, entry reveal, or other scroll-linked animation to implement.
checkOutcomes.reason: The channel has no parallax, scrollytelling, entry reveal, or other scroll-linked animation to implement.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The tested channel and search surfaces expose no swipe, pull, carousel, or gesture-driven control.
checkOutcomes.reason: The tested channel and search surfaces expose no swipe, pull, carousel, or gesture-driven control.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A persistent compact header keeps channel identity, search, and Join available while the feed scrolls; there is no oversized chrome requiring a shrink transition.
No tooltip, popover, menu, or other anchored overlay exists on the representative surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, menu, or other anchored overlay exists on the representative surfaces.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Date separators orient feed position, and the search result visibly highlights the matched term while preserving channel context.

checkOutcomes.method: Load screenshots at desktop and mobile
checkOutcomes.evidence: No popup, consent wall, or interstitial obscures the channel content on load.
No transient overlay, modal flow, disclosure, or custom picker exists on the tested surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No transient overlay, modal flow, disclosure, or custom picker exists on the tested surfaces.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The viewport is dominated by channel posts; the compact header and optional channel card do not obstruct reading.
At 360px, scrollWidth and innerWidth were both 360px, horizontalOverflowPx was 0, and mobile layout remained readable.
The destination is one fixed Telegram channel template with no same component reused in materially different container contexts.
checkOutcomes.reason: The destination is one fixed Telegram channel template with no same component reused in materially different container contexts.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus/target probe and Lighthouse target audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse passed aggregate target sizing, but the search input and icon-only link showed outline-style none when focused, and several text links render only 14-19px high.
The final page identifies the official channel and makes Join plus the latest Blacktoon address immediately visible.
Browser navigation follows the requested URL to the official channel; the latest address is a real link, and the search route returns a highlighted result.
Search preserves the query and highlights its match; the channel content remains server-rendered without an unresolved spinner or blank state.
Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 3.13s and CLS 0.150, outside good thresholds; trace corroboration measured LCP 1.59s with low blocking under a different run.
Lighthouse recorded CLS 0.150. A later layout observation saw no additional shift after its observation window, so the lab-load result is the stronger load signal.
The trace found one 57ms long task and only 7ms TBT; Lighthouse reported 0ms TBT.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against script DOM attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 301 adds a navigation; three high-priority stylesheets and six classic scripts load without async/defer, with 309KB transferred.
Lighthouse estimated 52KiB unused JavaScript (about 89% in jquery-ui and widget-frame) and 15KiB unused CSS.
All six images lack alt attributes, and the visible search input has no label or aria-label (placeholder only).
The Join action measured 3.31:1 and post metadata measured 4.14:1, below WCAG minimum for their sizes.
There is no h1; the only headings are four h5 footer labels, and the search input plus an icon link suppress visible focus outlines.
Korean post text reflows cleanly in readable lines without clipping or horizontal scrolling.

checkOutcomes.method: Viewport DOM probe and mobile layout
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reflow works at 360px and Lighthouse target sizing passes, but the viewport explicitly sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no, preventing user zoom.
Lighthouse recorded no browser console errors.
Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but all six img elements omit intrinsic width/height and the document jumps directly to h5 headings without an h1.
No deprecated APIs, prompt-on-load, source-map, or inspector issue appeared, but Lighthouse found two BFCache blockers caused by no-store responses.
The title is descriptive, but no meta description is present.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM links, robots request, viewport, and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: All 25 links have href values and non-generic text; a viewport meta exists and the original host serves robots.txt with HTTP 200.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP probes, DOM canonical, and Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: The original sitemap URL returned 403 to curl, the final t.me robots URL returned 404, and Lighthouse judged the pagination canonical invalid.
No JSON-LD is present; og:image and og:description exist but are empty, so shares cannot describe or preview the channel well.
HTTPS and HSTS are present and no insecure cookies or secrets were found, but browser-loaded response evidence has no CSP or X-Content-Type-Options.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR, trackers, cookies, and secrets primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: The redirect transfers 309KB from Telegram origins, but no known trackers, cookies, analytics origins, or exposed credentials were detected.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse permission audits and surface inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt, authentication, account, or sensitive action is part of this public channel surface.
checkOutcomes.reason: No permission prompt, authentication, account, or sensitive action is part of this public channel surface.

checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS and X-Frame-Options are set, but CSP, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and X-Content-Type-Options were absent in the browser response.
Raw HTML contains 92% of rendered content words and no empty SPA mount; crawler and rendered views both expose the posts.
The simple server-rendered feed/search has no clipped overlays or fragile async shell; search and scrolling remained stable.
This public redirect/channel is not an app-like installable tool; no manifest or controlling service worker is expected for its core purpose.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public redirect/channel is not an app-like installable tool; no manifest or controlling service worker is expected for its core purpose.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The tested surface is a read-only server-rendered document with ordinary links, not a fetch-driven stateful flow requiring in-page retry/stale-data UI.
checkOutcomes.reason: The tested surface is a read-only server-rendered document with ordinary links, not a fetch-driven stateful flow requiring in-page retry/stale-data UI.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The Korean channel document has neither html lang nor dir, so assistive technology and translation tools cannot identify its language/direction.
Korean content is mixed with fixed English UI/date labels such as July 10 and subscribers, with no document language signal indicating an intentional locale.
Post time elements use unambiguous ISO datetimes with an explicit +00:00 offset.
No consent wall, disguised advertisement, forced continuity, or confirmshaming appeared; outbound links are visibly presented as links.
The only input is optional channel search; there is no required or validation-bearing form to submit incorrectly.
checkOutcomes.reason: The only input is optional channel search; there is no required or validation-bearing form to submit incorrectly.

checkOutcomes.evidence: There are no address, payment, sign-in, sign-up, or personal-data inputs requiring autofill tokens; the only field is search.
checkOutcomes.reason: There are no address, payment, sign-in, sign-up, or personal-data inputs requiring autofill tokens; the only field is search.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription, consent, authentication, cancellation, or account-management flow exists on the representative surface.
checkOutcomes.reason: No checkout, subscription, consent, authentication, cancellation, or account-management flow exists on the representative surface.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The page transfers about 309KB total; its avatars are embedded SVG and Lighthouse passed appropriate image resolution despite small intrinsic-attribute gaps.
Only 31 requests, no known trackers, one 57ms long task, and 7ms TBT were observed; no idle polling or background over-fetching appeared.
No audio/video/autoplay exists; nearly all bytes come from Telegram because the requested host deliberately redirects there, and the total remains modest.
This read-only announcement channel exposes no transaction or tool capability for an agent to invoke; its content is already server-rendered.
checkOutcomes.reason: This read-only announcement channel exposes no transaction or tool capability for an agent to invoke; its content is already server-rendered.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The narrow channel/link experience has no summarisation or generative task whose core UX warrants built-in on-device inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: The narrow channel/link experience has no summarisation or generative task whose core UX warrants built-in on-device inference.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After 10 scroll/focus cycles, DOM count stayed 304, page heap grew 142KB, and snapshot self-size changed from 6,637,663 to 6,688,616 bytes (under 1%).

checkOutcomes.method: Heap snapshot totals and page metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: The content page snapshot is proportionate at about 6.64MB self-size with 109,786 nodes in the V8 heap graph and 304 live DOM elements.
Across 10 cycles the live DOM count did not grow, and instrumentation observed zero newly added listeners or intervals; snapshot node growth was only 492 (0.45%).

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable to this read-only channel surface.

paths.description: Requested URL redirect and public channel feed; represents entry, reading, current-address discovery, responsive layout, preferences, security, performance, and memory.
Latest address post detail; represents individual-message/deep-link reading.
Channel search result; represents the only form and interactive navigation flow.

findings.summary: Contrast preference does not preserve minimum contrast
findings.evidence: The high-contrast condition has no dedicated CSS, while Lighthouse records 3.31:1 and 4.14:1 combinations.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors/prefers-contrast adaptations and retest essential controls to WCAG contrast minimums.

findings.summary: Search navigation swaps abruptly
findings.evidence: Search performs a full navigation and no View Transition CSS is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin search/channel navigation, guarded by reduced-motion preferences.

findings.summary: Visible focus is missing on key controls
findings.evidence: The search input and icon-only link compute outline-style none under programmatic focus.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible treatment and ensure compact links have adequate target padding.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP and CLS miss good thresholds
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.13s and CLS 0.150.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP dependency chain, reserve all late layout space, and prioritize only the LCP-critical resources.

findings.summary: Load-time layout shift is measurable
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports CLS 0.150 even though a later observer window was stable.
findings.suggestedFix: Use explicit dimensions/aspect-ratio and stable font/layout placeholders for every load-time element.

findings.summary: Redirect and parser-ordered resources lengthen delivery
findings.evidence: The load includes a 301, three high-priority stylesheets, and six classic scripts without async/defer.
findings.suggestedFix: Redirect directly and reduce/defer non-critical scripts and styles while preserving document order only where required.

findings.summary: The destination ships avoidable unused CSS and JavaScript
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 52KiB unused JS and 15KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Split or conditionally load jQuery UI/widget code and page-specific CSS.

findings.summary: Images and search lack robust accessible names
findings.evidence: Six images have no alt and the search input relies on placeholder text.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark decorative avatars alt="" or provide meaningful alt; add a persistent label or aria-label to search.

findings.summary: Join and metadata text fail WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 3.31:1 on Join and 4.14:1 on 12px metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the blue/gray backgrounds or lighten foregrounds until text meets 4.5:1.

findings.summary: Heading hierarchy and focus visibility are incomplete
findings.evidence: The page has no h1, jumps to h5 footer headings, and suppresses focus on search/icon controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a channel h1, use sequential footer headings, and provide visible :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: Viewport settings block user zoom
findings.evidence: maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no prevent pinch zoom despite responsive reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions; keep width=device-width, initial-scale=1.

findings.summary: Images lack intrinsic dimensions and structure is weak
findings.evidence: All six img elements omit width/height, and headings begin at h5.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare intrinsic image dimensions and repair the heading outline.

findings.summary: No-store responses block back/forward cache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found main-resource and JavaScript-request no-store BFCache blockers.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cache directives compatible with BFCache for public channel content where freshness rules allow.

findings.summary: The public channel has no meta description
findings.evidence: DOM and Lighthouse both show a missing meta description.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise Korean description of the official channel and current-address purpose.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are inconsistent
findings.evidence: The sitemap endpoint returned 403, final robots returned 404, and Lighthouse rejected the canonical.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve consistent robots/sitemap responses and a valid absolute canonical for the public channel view.

findings.summary: Share metadata is empty and unstructured
findings.evidence: og:image and og:description are empty and no JSON-LD describes the channel.
findings.suggestedFix: Populate Open Graph image/description and add accurate Organization/WebPage JSON-LD.

findings.summary: Core content defenses are incomplete
findings.evidence: The browser response lacks CSP and X-Content-Type-Options despite HTTPS/HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, testing CSP in report-only mode first.

findings.summary: Referrer and permissions policies are absent
findings.evidence: Headers evidence lacks Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy in addition to CSP/nosniff.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a deliberate Referrer-Policy and least-privilege Permissions-Policy alongside CSP.

findings.summary: The Korean page omits document language
findings.evidence: html has no lang or dir and Lighthouse fails html-has-lang.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="ko" and an appropriate direction on the root document.

findings.summary: UI locale is inconsistent with Korean content
findings.evidence: The channel uses Korean content alongside English dates and labels without a declared language.
findings.suggestedFix: Format dates/counters for the selected locale and expose language changes explicitly when mixed.

taskList.title: Repair the accessibility foundation: set lang=ko, add an h1, label search, give images alt semantics, restore visible focus, and allow user zoom.
Reduce LCP and CLS by reserving intrinsic space and shortening the critical resource chain.
Deploy CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.
Provide consistent canonical, robots, sitemap, meta-description, Open Graph, and structured-data signals.
Raise text/control contrast and add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations.
Remove or defer unused scripts/styles and make public responses BFCache-compatible where safe.
Localize dates and interface labels consistently with the Korean channel.
Add reduced-motion-safe cross-document transitions for channel search navigation.
